messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- Team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the reporting service's owners. (since 2026-04-14; source standup/dune/2026-04-14-2)
- The reporting service is owned by the Ember team. (since 2026-04-13; source standup/ember/2026-04-13-2)
  - earlier: The reporting service is owned by team Dune. (held 2025-01-20 to 2026-04-13; source standup/dune/2025-01-20-2)
- [constraint] As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. (since 2025-08-19; source standup/dune/2025-08-19)
  - earlier: [constraint] Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. (held 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; source standup/ember/2025-02-06)
- From 2025-12-05, the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not team Dune. (since 2025-12-05; source handover/2025-12-05-reporting)
- [decision] As of 2025-12-05, reporting is owned by the Ember team, taking over from team Dune. (since 2025-12-05; source handover/2025-12-05-reporting)
- [decision] The Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday. (since 2026-02-03; source standup/atlas/2026-02-03)
- [decision] Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. (since 2025-05-22; source standup/boreal/2025-05-22)
- Farah is the release captain for Q3 2025. (since 2026-04-14; source standup/dune/2026-04-14-3)
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
  - earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. (held 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-01-21)
- feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. (since 2025-04-24; source standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2)
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. (since 2026-04-13; source standup/ember/2026-04-13-2)
- [constraint] The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, the peak season. (since 2025-11-11; source standup/atlas/2025-11-11)
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down. (since 2025-02-11; source standup/boreal/2025-02-11)
- [constraint] The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. (since 2025-03-26; source standup/dune/2025-03-26)
- The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so the webhook dispatcher is down whenever the bus is down. (since 2025-02-11; source standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2)
- As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the on-call rotation for the Ember team. (since 2026-01-15; source standup/ember/2026-01-15)
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the on-call rotation for the Ember team. (since 2026-05-29; source standup/ember/2026-05-29)
- As of 2026-03-11, Tomasz is back on the on-call rotation for team Dune. (since 2026-03-11; source standup/dune/2026-03-11)
  - earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the on-call rotation for team Dune. (held 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; source standup/dune/2026-01-16)
- [decision] As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. (since 2025-07-30; source standup/atlas/2025-07-30)
  - earlier: [decision] As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call. (held 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; source standup/atlas/2025-06-19)
- [constraint] The ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. (since 2026-03-11; source standup/cinder/2026-03-11)
